records.name: First World Transport Profiles
records.summary: Deterministic vehicle, animal, and harness profiles for caravan, river, and sea logistics.

harnessProfiles.name: Pack Rig
harnessProfiles.notes: Pack frames and lash points for individual beasts carrying cargo directly.

harnessProfiles.name: Light Draft Harness
harnessProfiles.notes: Shaft and trace harness for light carts and short-haul wagons.

harnessProfiles.name: Heavy Yoke
harnessProfiles.notes: Heavy yoke and trace rigging for dense loads and slow freight.

harnessProfiles.name: Caravan Team Harness
harnessProfiles.notes: Long-team traces, brake lines, and lash points for multi-animal road freight.

harnessProfiles.name: Pack Train Rig
harnessProfiles.notes: Lead lines, pack saddles, and line-order handling for multi-beast freight trains without wheeled vehicles.

animalProfiles.name: Horse
animalProfiles.notes: Fast and flexible but less efficient on steep grades than mules.

animalProfiles.name: Mule
animalProfiles.notes: Sure-footed freight animal with strong endurance and strong pass-country handling.

animalProfiles.name: Donkey
animalProfiles.notes: Cheap and dependable for light freight, especially on rough local tracks.

animalProfiles.name: Ox
animalProfiles.notes: Slow but powerful freight animal best suited to dense loads on prepared routes.

vehicleProfiles.name: Cart
vehicleProfiles.notes: Standard small freight cart for ordinary road hauling between villages and nearby markets.

vehicleProfiles.name: Wagon
vehicleProfiles.notes: Standard four-wheel freight wagon for maintained roads, bridge corridors, and market hauling.

vehicleProfiles.name: Caravan Wagon
vehicleProfiles.notes: Long-haul guarded freight wagon built for regional caravan corridors and sustained bulk movement.

vehicleProfiles.name: Small River Boat
vehicleProfiles.notes: Light inland hull for river freight, fishing support, and courier movement on sheltered water.

vehicleProfiles.name: Barge
vehicleProfiles.notes: Bulk inland water hauler for grain, ore, timber, and other dense river freight.

vehicleProfiles.name: Small Trader
vehicleProfiles.notes: Small coastal trader balancing speed, shallow-draft access, and modest cargo space.

vehicleProfiles.name: Trade Ship
vehicleProfiles.notes: Primary cargo-focused open-water merchant hull for interregional maritime trade.

vehicleProfiles.name: Military Vessel
vehicleProfiles.notes: Escort and patrol vessel with higher speed, more crew, and reduced cargo volume.

vehicleProfiles.name: Hand Cart
vehicleProfiles.notes: One-person hand cart for short-haul urban and village freight.

vehicleProfiles.name: Push Cart
vehicleProfiles.notes: Heavier human-powered cart suited to paved streets, quays, and short market runs.

vehicleProfiles.name: Pack Train
vehicleProfiles.notes: Multi-beast overland freight line for rough country where wagons lose too much efficiency.

vehicleProfiles.name: Light Cart
vehicleProfiles.notes: Light draft cart optimized for short couriering, farm haulage, and feeder market traffic.

vehicleProfiles.name: Heavy Cart
vehicleProfiles.notes: Dense-load cart for quarry, mine, timber, and other short heavy-haul work.

vehicleProfiles.name: Light Wagon
vehicleProfiles.notes: Fast wagon for lightly packed merchant loads on reliable roads.

vehicleProfiles.name: Heavy Wagon
vehicleProfiles.notes: Slow heavy wagon for dense freight where capacity matters more than pace.

vehicleProfiles.name: Freight Wagon
vehicleProfiles.notes: Dedicated bulk road freight wagon for grain, ore, timber, and other high-volume cargo.

vehicleProfiles.name: Military Supply Wagon
vehicleProfiles.notes: Supply wagon tuned for disciplined escorted freight rather than pure commercial efficiency.

vehicleProfiles.name: Fishing Skiff
vehicleProfiles.notes: Small near-shore working boat suited to day fishing, reef work, and light harbor transfer.

vehicleProfiles.name: Ferry
vehicleProfiles.notes: Dedicated crossing craft for people, carts, and short river transfers.

vehicleProfiles.name: Tow Barge
vehicleProfiles.notes: Very heavy inland bulk hauler optimized for towpath or slow-river freight.

vehicleProfiles.name: Fishing Vessel
vehicleProfiles.notes: Crewed coastal fishing hull balancing net gear, hold space, and coastal range.

vehicleProfiles.name: Coastal Cargo Ship
vehicleProfiles.notes: Purpose-built coastal cargo hull prioritizing hold space over maneuver speed.

vehicleProfiles.name: Fast Courier Vessel
vehicleProfiles.notes: Fast packet and courier hull optimized for urgent dispatches and light high-value cargo.
